title: Adopt single-orchestrator assignment and directory lanes in MULTI_AGENT.md
changes_summary: MULTI_AGENT.md now states that workers act only on orchestrator-assigned issues and never self-claim.
Directory lanes (driver/, tools/, apps/, docs/, extensions/, vst-host/, src/) are documented with a one-active-writer-per-lane limit.
Tool-provided worktree isolation is the default mechanism; the #124 occupancy check is explicitly recorded as fallback.
CONFLICT_POLICY.md routes cross-lane arbitration to the orchestrator instead of first-commit ownership.
AGENTS.md entry rules point at orchestrator assignment, handoff-block owner confirmation and worktree occupancy checks without contradicting the new model.
limitations: Documentation/workflow-only change; no product API, IPC/schema, DSP order, RT-thread, driver boundary or release behavior change.
Entry documents outside this slice still contain legacy self-claim wording; follow-up slice required for docs/START_HERE.md, SPEC-0004, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and templates.
